result.reason: The operative language includes the preferred CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy, workers’ compensation, and certificate requirements, and it preserves the existing risk-of-loss allocation. However, requiring every policy—including CGL and workers’ compensation—to remain in place for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not narrowly tailored; any post-termination requirement should generally be limited to claims-made E&O and cyber coverage, if needed. Otherwise, the provision is professionally drafted.
